items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Interviewee repeatedly asks 'Mamie who?' and 'Mamie Desdune? Desdune?' indicating lack of personal recognition or close relationship.

ctx.x: I know what I wanted to ask you. Did you know Mamie Dad's doing them? She was a piano player.
Desdune. She played mostly blues, you know?
I know them. Know plenty about it. See them but don't know the name.
I know what I wanted to ask you. Did you know Mamie Dad's doing them? She was a piano player.
